title: Pick up and drop off as a rider
intro: Let's add a rider, then follow one delivery from pick up to drop off.

steps.caption: Your riders
steps.vo: Your riders are under Business, in Riders. You can see who's free and who's busy.

steps.caption: Add a rider
steps.vo: Tap Add a rider. Type their name, phone number and plate number, then tap Send invite. They get a link to the rider app on WhatsApp.

steps.caption: Go online, see the job
steps.vo: The rider opens the app from that link. When they're online, new jobs show up on Today. They tap See job.

steps.caption: Step 1: pick up
steps.vo: Step one is pick up. At the shop, they ask for the order number, then tap I'm there, enter code.

steps.caption: Step 2: drop off
steps.vo: Step two is drop off. For pay on delivery, they collect the cash before they hand over the parcel.

steps.caption: Enter the customer's code
steps.vo: At the door, they enter the customer's four-digit code to finish. They can add a proof of delivery photo too.

steps.caption: See what they earned
steps.vo: In Earnings, riders see what they made this week.

outro: Now your riders know exactly where to go, every time.
